    result = truncate_number(5.000001)
    assert math.isclose(result, 0.000001, abs_tol=FLOAT_TOLERANCE)

    """Large integer parts should not affect the extracted decimal part."""
    result = truncate_number(987654321.25)
    assert math.isclose(result, 0.25, abs_tol=FLOAT_TOLERANCE)

    """Zero should decompose into a zero decimal part."""
    result = truncate_number(0.0)
    assert math.isclose(result, 0.0, abs_tol=FLOAT_TOLERANCE)


def test_truncate_number_return_type_is_float() -> None:
    """The function should always return a float value."""
    result = truncate_number(8.75)
    assert isinstance(result, float)
